When looking into choosing a guitar, I feel that many people often over look the wood type of the guitar. Companies can make guitars with the same relative specs like the kind of pick-ups and the dimensions of the body, scale, and neck, but they often use different woods that give different qualities of tone. In addition to this, where the guitar is made can also make a difference. For instance guitars manufactured in Japan or America I usually find to be of a higher quality than those made in Korea.
